Since the Change is batch routing for two-or-more PR arguments and this case has a single argument, the single-PR path should remain byte-for-byte the same as Before; keep the no-progress effect as 'no helper dispatched, checkpoint retained, record untouched, draft suggestion surfaced only in the blocker text and fix option' so the batch wording never alters zero/one-PR behavior.
